artifact_console_truncated: Only the newest lines are kept.
artifact_diff_none: This is the first version, so there is nothing to compare it with yet.
artifact_edit_carried: Your edited version travels with your next message.
artifact_empty_body: Ask for a page, a drawing or a small game.
artifact_fix_request: It did not run. Can you help me fix it?
artifact_save_failed: The edit could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
chat_attachment_refusal_attachments_disa: Attachments are switched off in this class.
chat_attachment_refusal_image_input_not_: This model cannot look at pictures. Try a text file, or ask your teacher for another model.
chat_attachment_refusal_too_many: That is one file too many.
chat_attachment_refusal_type_not_allowed: That kind of file cannot be attached here.
chat_attachment_refusal_unavailable: That file could not be attached.
chat_editing_notice: Editing an earlier message. Sending creates a new branch.
chat_empty_body: Ask for something to build, or just ask a question.
chat_image_refusal_no_generation_alias: Making pictures is not switched on in this class.
chat_image_refusal_unavailable: Pictures cannot be made right now. Try again in a moment.
chat_notice_budget: This answer stopped early to stay inside today's limits.
chat_notice_error: The assistant is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
chat_notice_interrupted: This answer was cut short. Ask again to continue.
chat_notice_unanswered: No answer was given, so the assistant carried on without the tool.
chat_permission_declined_notice: You said no. The answer continues without it.
chat_refusal_classroom_cap_exhausted: Your class has used today's shared allowance. It starts again tomorrow.
chat_refusal_classroom_locked: Your teacher has locked the classroom. You cannot send messages right now.
chat_refusal_model_not_allowed: This model is not available in your class. Ask your teacher.
chat_refusal_outside_schedule: The classroom is closed. You can write again during the next lesson.
chat_refusal_student_allowance_exhausted: You have used today's allowance. It starts again tomorrow.
chat_refusal_unavailable: You cannot send a message right now. Ask your teacher.
chat_turn_in_flight: Wait for the current answer to finish, or stop it first.
classroom_closed_locked: Your teacher has locked the classroom.
classroom_closed_meanwhile: Your conversations are still here when the classroom opens.
classroom_closed_outside: There is no lesson right now.
classroom_no_next_opening: Your teacher will open it again.
creations_empty_body: Everything you build and every picture you make is kept here until you delete it.
educator_alias_dpa_label: Covered by a data processing agreement
educator_alias_in_use: This model cannot be removed: pupils have already used it, and its usage has to stay accounted for. Switch it out of service instead.
educator_alias_input_price_label: Input price, USD per million tokens
educator_alias_name_taken: A model with that name already exists. Pick another name.
educator_alias_output_price_label: Output price, USD per million tokens
educator_alias_save_failed: That change could not be saved.
educator_alias_utility_label: Use for internal work such as titles
educator_allowlist_empty: No models yet. Add one under Models first.
educator_cards_once: These codes are shown once. Print or write them down before you leave this page.
educator_classroom_daily_label: Tokens for the class per day
educator_classroom_instructions_help: Added to every conversation in this class. Pupils never see it.
educator_creation_retention_hint: Leave empty to keep them until a pupil deletes them.
educator_delete_classroom_body: Everything in this room goes: every pupil's record, their conversations, their creations, their uploads and the usage recorded against them. There is nothing to undo it with. Type the classroom's name to confirm.
educator_delete_classroom_mismatch: That is not the classroom's name. Nothing was deleted.
educator_login_failed: That username and password did not work.
educator_login_intro: Sign in with the educator account for this Setun instance.
educator_no_classrooms: No classrooms yet. Create one to begin.
educator_no_dpa_confirm_body: Prompts and attachments from this class will reach a provider that has not signed a data processing agreement. In a school, what pupils write — and images all the more — is personal data, however pseudonymous the account. You are making this choice for this class.
educator_no_dpa_confirm_title: This model has no data processing agreement
educator_permission_open_warning: Every enabled tool will run without asking the pupil first, including tools you marked “ask first”.
educator_permission_standard: Ask only for tools marked “ask first”
educator_provision_help: Each pupil gets a spoken name and one access code. The code is shown here once and cannot be looked up again.
educator_recovery_command_intro: From the deployment directory, ask the host operator to run:
educator_recovery_copy_failed: Could not copy the command. Select it and copy it manually.
educator_recovery_effect: The command asks for a new username and hidden password, signs out every educator session, and leaves pupil sessions and work untouched.
educator_recovery_intro: Only an operator with shell access to the Setun host can reset the educator account. The browser never performs the reset.
educator_schedule_empty: No lessons scheduled. Add one below.
educator_session_policy_label: How long pupils stay signed in
educator_skill_import_unavailable: The registry could not be reached. Upload the skill as a file instead.
educator_skill_upload_failed: That file could not be read as a skill.
educator_skill_upload_help: A Markdown or text file. It arrives switched off until you enable it.
educator_skills_intro: A skill is a name, one line of description, and a set of instructions the model reads when it needs them. Uploaded and imported text arrives switched off.
educator_slip_bulk_confirm: Create new access codes for all {count} active pupils? Their current codes and signed-in sessions will stop working.
educator_slip_bulk_empty: There are no active pupils to create slips for.
educator_slip_bulk_stale: The active roster changed while the slips were being prepared. Nothing was changed; review the roster and try again.
educator_slip_bulk_submit: Create slips for all {count} active pupils
educator_slip_code_instruction: Enter the access code above if you do not scan.
educator_slip_inactive: This pupil is not active. You can create a new slip, but it cannot sign in until the account is active.
educator_slip_keep_instruction: Keep this slip private. Ask your teacher for a new one if lost.
educator_slip_page_label: Printable Setun access slips, page {page} of {pages}
educator_slip_pdf_failed: The PDF could not be created. The preview is still available; try again or print it.
educator_slip_qr_warning: One or more QR codes could not be created. The printed access codes still work.
educator_slip_ready_classroom: {count} access slips are ready to print or download.
educator_slip_ready_student: The access slip for {label} is ready to print or download.
educator_slip_rotate_confirm: Create a new access code for {label}? The current code and all signed-in sessions will stop working.
educator_slip_security: Anyone with a copy of a slip can sign in as that pseudonymous pupil. The QR code keeps the access code in the URL fragment, which is not sent in requests or referrers and is removed from browser history before sign-in.
educator_slip_sign_in_instruction: Scan the QR code to sign in to Setun.
educator_student_delete_mismatch: That name did not match. Nothing was deleted.
educator_student_skills_empty: No pupil has written a skill yet.
educator_tool_allowlist_empty: No tools are configured yet. Add a server in the configuration file, then switch its tools on under Tools.
educator_tool_sensitive_help: In standard mode a tool marked this way asks the pupil before it runs.
educator_tools_intro: Servers are defined in the configuration file on disk. The panel switches them on and chooses which of their tools a class may use.
home_tagline: A privacy-first learning environment for teaching AI and Teknologiforståelse.
login_failed: That code did not work. Check it and try again.
login_help: Lost your card? Ask your teacher for a new code.
login_intro: Enter the access code from your card.
login_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts from this network. Wait a few minutes, then try again — your code is fine.
setup_alias_intro: Pupils pick models by the friendly name you give them here.
setup_alias_utility_note: This model is also used for internal work such as naming conversations.
setup_claim_held_body: Another browser holds this setup. If that was you in another window, close it and try again after the time below.
setup_claim_held_title: Someone else is setting Setun up
setup_claim_intro: Setun printed a one-time token to its log when it started. Paste it here to continue.
setup_claim_where: Run docker compose logs app on the server and look for the setup panel. The token is valid for 15 minutes; restarting Setun prints a new one.
setup_classroom_alias_note: {alias} will be available to this class.
setup_classroom_intro: A class is where everything is configured: who is in it, which models it may use, when it is open. Everything else has a sensible default you can change later.
setup_classroom_no_dpa_body: In a school with minors, what pupils type — and any image they attach — is personal data, whatever the account is called. Enabling this model for a class means the provider receives it with no agreement in place.
setup_classroom_no_dpa_confirm: I understand, and I am enabling it for this class anyway.
setup_classroom_no_dpa_title: This model has no data processing agreement
setup_educator_intro: One account runs Setun. There is no password reset inside the app — write this down somewhere safe.
setup_error_claim_lost: This browser no longer holds the setup. Unlock it again to carry on.
setup_error_classroom_missing: The class could not be found. Go back a step.
setup_error_educator_seeded: The account comes from deployment configuration and cannot be changed here.
setup_error_incomplete: Setup is not finished yet: an account, a model and a class are all needed.
setup_error_invalid: Something in that form was not right. Check it and try again.
setup_error_invalid_credentials: That username and password did not match.
setup_error_invalid_token: That token is not right, or it has expired. Restart Setun to print a new one.
setup_error_no_dpa_unconfirmed: Confirm what a model without a data processing agreement means before continuing.
setup_error_no_educator: There is no account yet, so there is nothing to sign in with. Use the token from the log.
setup_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
setup_error_setup_claimed: Another browser is setting Setun up right now.
setup_finish_intro: Setun is ready. Finishing signs you in to the panel and closes this page for good.
setup_gateway_fail_note: Setun cannot reach the gateway. Fix it now and check again, or carry on and sort it out later — pupils cannot chat until it answers.
setup_gateway_intro: Setun talks to models through CLIProxyAPI. This checks that it answers.
setup_gateway_ok_note: The gateway is answering. Carry on.
setup_intro: Setun has not been set up yet. This takes a few minutes and happens once.
setup_recover_intro: Once the account exists you can take setup back with it instead. Nothing else changes.
setup_students_again: Creating pupils again adds a second batch — it does not replace the first.
setup_students_intro: Optional. Create pupils here, or later from the roster.
stack_check_dialog_description: If the radius, colours, fonts and open animation match the clean-slate theme, the UnoCSS and shadcn-svelte pairing is wired correctly.
stack_check_font_mono: JetBrains Mono renders the mono stack.
stack_check_intro: This scratch route renders shadcn-svelte components against the clean-slate theme variables. Every string here comes from a Paraglide message — no literals in components.
student_creations_count: {artifacts} things you built, {images} pictures you made
student_display_name_help: Optional, and yours to change or remove. Never use your real name.
student_skill_pending_notice: Your teacher needs to approve this before it works.
student_skill_rejected_notice: Your teacher did not approve this one.
student_skills_disabled_notice: Writing skills is switched off in this class.
student_skills_empty: You have not written a skill yet.
student_skills_intro: A skill tells the assistant how you want it to work. Write one, try it, and change it.
validation_gateway_model_unknown: The gateway does not serve a model called that. It serves: {models}
validation_passwords_differ: The two passwords are not the same.
validation_price_not_a_number: Enter a price as a number, or leave it empty.
validation_price_too_large: That price is implausibly high. Prices are per million tokens.
validation_retention_range: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 3650, or leave it empty.
